_about: 퀘스트 id를 키로 적는 보완·수정 이름표이며, 필드별 우선순위는 수동(game: 다른 출처에 없거나 오류를 바로잡는 특수한 경우의 게임 직접 확인값) > tarkov.dev(same_as 포함) > SPT(이름·맵만) > 위키·블로그 > 미확인이다. same_as = 같은 퀘스트인데 tarkov.dev에는 다른 id로 있는 경우 그 id. 선택 항목: maps(맵 구분값 목록), objectives([{text, original, optional?}]), prep([{kind, text, count, fir}]), level. from = 정보 출처(wiki: 공식 위키, blog: 공략 블로그, game: 게임 화면 직접 확인). link_blog = 위키로 출처를 변경하기 전의 블로그 주소. check = 사용자 검토 대기 표시(wiki/blog); 검토 완료 후 제거하며 from은 유지한다. replaced_by / replaced_by_en = 삭제·대체된 퀘스트의 후속 퀘스트 안내(한국어/영어). raid(true/false) = 레이드 안에서 하는 퀘스트인지 직접 지정 (tarkov.dev에 있는 퀘스트에도 쓸 수 있음). 영어 화면용(선택): name_en, objective_en, prep[].text_en (objectives 는 original 이 영어 문장). 필드별 우선순위: game > dev > SPT > wiki > blog > unknown. checked = 마지막 확인 날짜(YYYY-MM-DD). BTR 정류장 보완값은 btr_stops에 기록한다.

btr_stops._note: BTR stops missing on tarkov.dev. Used only while tarkov.dev has no stops for that map. Lighthouse positions were read from the stop map image on the official wiki (BTR Driver page, Lighthouse_BTR_stops_map.png, 2026-11-20) and aligned to the tarkov.dev map with 8 reference points (about 10 m accuracy). All stops are at ground level.

extracts._note: Extracts missing on tarkov.dev, listed in the extraction table of the official wiki map page. name = in-game exit id (matches quest exitName), name_en = name shown on the map. Used only while tarkov.dev has no extract with the same name or name_en on that map. Lighthouse V-Ex position was read from the Jindouz Lighthouse map V2.6.1 on the wiki (Jindouz_Lighthouse_Map_V1.png, 2026-11-21) and aligned to tarkov.dev with 4 nearby reference points (Northern Checkpoint, Industrial Zone Gates, transits to Reserve and Woods; error 1-3 m). Terminal positions were read from the RE3MR wiki map and aligned to tarkov.dev using 9 fuel tank centers (error about 1-3 m).

extracts.name: V-Ex_light
extracts.note: Single-use, 5000 RUB per player (depends on Scav karma), max 5 players

extracts.name: Zubr Boat
extracts.note: Single-use; seats depend on players who entered: 1-3 players: 3 seats; 4 players: 3-4 seats (random); 5 players: 4-5 seats (random). Players who brought Secure container Alpha-1 with TerraGroup evidence must carry it. Opening the Pier door starts a 3-minute extraction timer for everyone; reach the boat before it ends.

boss_zones._note: Boss zones measured from the official wiki map. Used only while tarkov.dev has no valid positions at the same spawn_location; dev positions win. Terminal: Terminal_Bosses_Map.jpg in the RE3MR frame aligned using 9 fuel tank centers (request 45); center and approximate 13 m radius measured by Claude.

enemy_spawns._note: User in-game knowledge takes priority over dev only when from is game. Positions are from Claude's guide measurements or the stated dev references; all y = -59. Non-game positions only fill missing dev positions. Groups must still exist by exact dev spawn-location name. merge_into adds counts at the target position without a separate marker.

Zone1BD1HangarBD11.note: 4 inside the Seaport terminal / MS building; 8 outside remain in HangarAmbush11. Position: MS weapon box measured by Claude.

Zone1BDGateAmbush13.note: 2 in front of the D3 locked door; position matches the Black Division keycard lock.

Zone1BD1PortAmbush1.note: 2 at the starting port, confirmed in game. Dev entries appear to be alternatives, not a total of 5. Position: existing dev group center.

Zone2BDWarehouse18.note: SZ-1 area: about 4 total after adding Warehouse19. Keep the Warehouse18 position.

Zone2BDWarehouse19.note: Add these 2 to Warehouse18 at its position; one marker for the SZ-1 area.

Zone2BDColumns23.note: 2 opposite the key side at the pump station. Estimated position: center of friendly Zone2VSRFColumns22 with the same Columns zone name.

Zone2BDPort32.note: 3 on the last pier toward the boat extract; moved from the dev pier-corner center.
